title: Ford Expedition Engines by Year (1997–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Ford Expedition by year, 1997–2026: the 4.6 and 5.4 Triton V8s, the three-valve 5.4, and the 3.5 EcoBoost V6 and its High Output tune.
intro: Ford's full-size Expedition replaced the Bronco for 1997, with the longer EL (now MAX) from 2007. Engines offered only in the Lincoln Navigator are not listed.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: Second generation
intro: The 4.6 and 5.4, then the three-valve 5.4 alone from 2005.

generations.name: Third generation
intro: The 5.4 three-valve V8, flex-fuel from 2009, then the 3.5 EcoBoost from 2015.

generations.name: Fourth generation
intro: The 3.5 EcoBoost V6 in standard and High Output tunes, including the Timberline.

generations.name: Fifth generation
intro: The 3.5 EcoBoost V6, with the High Output standard on the Tremor.
